summary: First end-to-end test run of Vaultra DigiGold multi-tenant mobile app. Backend: 25/25 pytest cases passing covering all /api endpoints (price/quote, OTP auth, buy->mock-confirm with 3% GST, grams/rupees modes, sell/redeem KYC gating, SIP CRUD+run+toggle, admin login+lockout, tenant-scoped STF002 visibility, kyc-queue+decision, pickup OTP collect (wrong decrements), counter-sale, ledger reverse mirrors entries and adjusts balance). Frontend (390x844 web preview): home renders tenant switch, live ticker, buy widget (rupees chip 2000 -> base 2000 + GST 60 = 2060 total matching PRD), banner carousel. Login OTP autofill flow works, PaymentSheet opens, pay button credits vault, 'Gold added' success toast with invoice shown, vault balance pill updates to 2.0923g / ₹14,785. Vault screen shows portfolio, pickup OTP card (482913), passbook filters all/buy/sell/sip/redemption. Jewellery screen shows filters and 'Redeem with Vault Gold'. SIP screen shows active SIP with Pay now/Pause/Delete. Admin login (STF001/1234) opens dark console with live event stream, tenant filters, stat tiles, pickups (3 pending with Collect buttons), POS counter sale calculator, KYC queue + reviewed. No console errors detected across any flow.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: broaden tests for malabar tenant scoping and 429 OTP rate-limit path.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~890 lines; nearing the 700-line split threshold. Consider splitting into routers (public, auth, buy, admin) as it grows.
OTP challenge rate-limit (5/min per phone) is correctly enforced; tests had to use class-scoped login fixture to avoid tripping it.
finalize_order is correctly idempotent via find_one_and_update on status=created; good.
MongoDB _id is consistently excluded via projection {"_id":0} across endpoints.
seed_data_creation: Reused server.py seed(). Playwright test created users phone=9000011122, pytest created 9000012345/9000098765/9000055555/9800011122.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use pytest -n 0 for backend (OTP rate-limit means class-scoped login fixtures are essential; see test_vaultra_api.py). Mongo cleanup for test phones is in test setup commands. Frontend testIDs are comprehensive: tab-{home,vault,jewellery,sip}, buy-mode-{rupees,grams}, quick-chip-{amt}, proceed-to-buy-button, payment-sheet, payment-method-{upi,card,netbanking}, payment-pay-button, admin-tab-{dashboard,kyc,pickups,pos}, admin-tenant-filter-{all,vaultra,tanishq,malabar}, pickup-collect-{id}, pos-{phone-input,weight-x,method-x,generate-bill-button}, kyc-{queue-item-id,approve-button,reject-button}. Admin login route is /admin/login.
